scripts.db:tables: npx wrangler d1 execute blog-analysis-db --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table'" --remote
scripts.db:tables:local: npx wrangler d1 execute blog-analysis-db --local --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='table'"
scripts.db:rss: npx wrangler d1 execute blog-analysis-db --command="SELECT * FROM blog_rss LIMIT 10" --remote
scripts.db:reports: npx wrangler d1 execute blog-analysis-db --command="SELECT * FROM blog_report LIMIT 10" --remote
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject --org euijin --project node-cloudflare-workers ./dist && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org euijin --project node-cloudflare-workers ./dist
